prompt:
Create ONE polished native editable SVG with TWO non-canid fantasy creature portraits: a moss-backed ram, normal LEFT and ascended RIGHT. Future Last Hearth expansion visual concept only, no canon, text or UI. Exact canvas 1600x560, viewBox="0 0 1600 560". Two 800x560 cells. Top-level groups id="ram-normal" transform="translate(0 0)" and id="ram-ascended" transform="translate(800 0)". All artwork inside each cell x=48..752 y=42..518. Each group starts with a local 800x560 forest-ink #172928 background rectangle. No other top-level painted content. No labels or frames.
Same ram identity both scenes: heavy curled ochre keratin horns grow from a wedge skull; narrow intelligent eyes fitted in brow; connected muzzle, neck, shoulder, broad wool chest and cloven hooves. Natural umber/cream creature colors, selective moss sage, tiny aged brass accent. Strong continuous curved anatomy, three broad readable values, asymmetric engraved fantasy illustration. Upper-left ivory light; broad planes first, sparse form-following cuts, quiet regions. No tiny curls everywhere, no pasted-on limbs, no mascot eyes, no all-gold body.
NORMAL: three-quarter low head, compressed shoulders, front hooves planted together on a low dark stone; one thick horn overlaps cheek; its curved back leads diagonally down to a quiet rear haunch. Patient grounded guard.
ASCENDED: head and shoulder turn upward toward the left, one forehoof reaches firmly onto a higher broken stone while the other supports weight below; long neck opens a triangular negative space above the stepping leg. Larger grown-back moss mantle follows shoulders, horn silhouette opens wider. Change gesture, support and contour, not just color. Keep hooves visibly connected to bent legs and stone contact. Do not duplicate or mirror the normal pose.
Family reference from actual game: natural creatures on quiet dark forest fields, modeled cut planes and selective worn gold; current Hearth guard portraits use 160x112 art with 64x45 smallest board view. Read clear horns/head/weight at those scales. Restrained forest ink #172928, umber #75614c, wool ivory #dfd4b4, sage #789579, horn ochre #b79a65, copper #b97c5e. Use curved anatomy, not blocky polygons.
Static self-contained SVG paths and simple shapes only. Native vector, no embedded raster, external resource, script, animation, use, visible text, logo, watermark, card border or stats. Avoid gradients, filters and defs; use explicit flat modeled planes. Each cell extracts as a complete 800x560 illustration.
